title: Tenants
description: Every tenant in the suite, with its apps and domains.
createHint: The tenant admin signs in with the temporary password and can change it on first use.
appsDescription: Turning an app on adds it to this tenant's console after a reload.
domainHint: Keycloak redirects follow the domains recorded here. A tenant host cannot use a wildcard.
emptyHint: Create the first tenant to give a team its console.
noApps: No apps are enabled for this tenant.
codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes; it becomes the tenant host.
